regulatory_history.title: State of Texas v. The Allstate Corp. et al. (Cause No. 25-01-00561)
regulatory_history.notes: Brought under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, the Data Broker Law and the Insurance Code. Pending against the remaining defendants. Life360 is not a defendant.

procedural_note.text: On 2025-04-10 the Texas court dismissed The Allstate Corporation and Arity 875 LLC for lack of personal jurisdiction (MLex); that dismissal is on appeal and the case continues against the remaining Allstate entities.

regulatory_history.title: In re Allstate and Arity Consumer Privacy Litigation (N.D. Ill. No. 25-cv-407)
regulatory_history.body: US District Court, Northern District of Illinois
regulatory_history.notes: Consolidated 2025-04-10. On 2026-03-03 the court denied most of the defendants' motion to dismiss (counts II, IX and XXXI dismissed); the defendants answered 2026-04-24. Pending; not proven. Life360 is not a defendant.
